newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Pannonplast Polifoam unit raises capital.
newsitem.headline: Pannonplast Polifoam unit raises capital.

text.p: Hungary's Polifoam Kft, part of Pannonplast Muanyagipari Rt plastics group, raised its share capital and simultaneously, Germany's HT Troplast AG acquired an 17.9 percent stake, company officials said on Wednesday.
With HT Troplast's entry, Polifoam's share capital grew to 422 million forints, up 75.4 million.
"The purchase was accompanied by a capital increase and this ensured a part of financing for further development," Pannonplast's president and CEO, Erzsebet Feher, told a news conference.
Polifoam plans to increase its polyethylene output capacity to 1,700 tonnes per year from the present 700 tonnes with a 600 million forint investment, aiming at a regional market leading position.
Polifoam's other shareholders are Pannonplast with a 60 percent stake, and Japan's Furukawa Electric Co and Itochu Co.
Polifoam expects a turnover of 750 million forints in 1996, with 65 percent of this from exports.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange Pannonplast shares closed at 5,100 forints, up 60.
